calls_found.description: Software Engineering for AI and generative AI (RIA) (AI/Data/Robotics Partnership) | Expected Outcome: Improved methods and tools to optimally develop and deliver bias-free AI algorithms and generative AI. New concepts of the auto-evolution-enabled software elements that AI algorithms can autonomously select and integrate.
